name: Bead String
summary: A tag input where every tag becomes a glossy bead that flies onto a sagging thread
about: A tag field for a shop profile, drawn as a bead tray with three threads. Each tag you add turns into a glossy bead that arcs up from the field and lands on a thread, which sags under the weight and wobbles; removing a bead snaps it off so it drops and bounces while the others slide together. Saving ties the threads with a bow and runs a glint along every bead.
how: Type a tag and press Enter or a comma (or press Add); paste a comma list to add several at once
Tap a Popular tag to send it flying onto the string; duplicates shake instead of being added
Click a bead (or focus it and press Delete) to snap it off; Backspace twice in an empty field removes the last one
Up to 8 tags fit; the counter turns red when the strings are full
Press Save tags to tie the threads and see the saved list
